children: SEOUL (dpa-AFX) - South Korean tobacco maker KT&G Corp. (033780.KS) Thursday reported higher third-quarter operating income as sales increased from a year earlier.
Quarterly operating income rose 13.9% to 530.08 billion won from 465.29 billion won a year before.
Meanwhile, Net income attributable to shareholders fell 74.7% to 106.10 billion won from 419.25 billion won last year.
Profit before income tax from continuing operations declined to 173.98 billion won from 544.23 billion won in the year-ago quarter.
Sales increased 4.3% to 1.91 trillion won from 1.83 trillion won in the year-ago period.
Shares of KT&G closed Thursday's trading 1.15% higher at 194,200.00 won on KSE.
